# Version 4.156.2 (Unreleased)
> **Image and glyph correctness**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.156.2 update corrects filtered image sampling and mask-filtered glyph rendering. These same-milestone native fixes also align image-filter cache lookups with hashing, without changing managed APIs.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Keep antialiased image sampling within bounds** — Ganesh image draws and filters constrain sampling to the intended texture subset under minification, strong skew, AA clipping and MSAA, preventing unrelated backing-texture pixels from contaminating the output. ([#5773](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5773))
- **Make image-filter cache keys consistent** — Cache equality now matches bytewise hashing for signed zero, matrix type metadata and subnormal values, keeping lookups and eviction consistent. ([#5773](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5773))
- **Handle changing glyph loads safely** — Mask-filtered text uses the reloaded glyph's path and validates mask compatibility when successive font-scaler loads differ. This prevents stale outlines and sub-byte buffer overwrites, and corrects clipped embossed-mask planes. ([#5742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5742))
